title: The Diary of a Nobody
author: George Grossmith · Weedon Grossmith
description: "The Diary of a Nobody" by George and Weedon Grossmith is a comic novel published in 1892.
longDescription: It chronicles fifteen months in the life of Charles Pooter, a London clerk whose inflated sense of self-importance collides constantly with everyday reality. Through daily entries, readers witness his domestic troubles, social mishaps, and minor humiliations as he navigates lower-middle-class Victorian life with his wife Carrie and friends.
